Review an original Verilog module against the supplied public role and
fixed-configuration behavior. Candidates can be healthy or contain a historical
defect; you receive no label, corrected RTL, maintainer patch or audit result.
Return decision=keep with edits=[] if no functional repair is needed, otherwise
decision=repair with up to 12 line-range replacements. Line numbers refer to the
ORIGINAL editable file, including blank lines; start_line/end_line are inclusive.
Replacements are complete line blocks; a missing final newline is appended by
the patch applicator. No functional change is made by the controller.
Preserve the exact license/interface prefix, public ports, parameter defaults,
compiler directives and module names. Do not edit dependencies. New plain reg
declarations and synthesizable constant initial assignments are allowed where
needed. No runtime system tasks/file reads, hierarchy, functions/tasks, new
clocking event forms, timing delays, assumptions/assertions, compiler pragmas,
input drivers or extra modules. Avoid unrelated refactors. Public historical
code can have appeared in model training; this is not an unseen benchmark.
Return only the JSON schema:
{"type": "object", "properties": {"decision": {"type": "string", "enum": ["keep", "repair"]}, "edits": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"start_line": {"type": "integer"}, "end_line": {"type": "integer"}, "replacement": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["start_line", "end_line", "replacement"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "explanation": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["decision", "edits", "explanation"], "additionalProperties": false}

Public contract:
{"module_role": "Frame-length monitor. Supported TKEEP values are contiguous low-order ones (2^k-1, including zero); noncontiguous masks are outside this artifact contract. Count those enabled bytes only on valid AND ready transfers; report each completed frame, including consecutive single-word frames and stalls.", "top": "axis_frame_len", "clock": "clk", "ports": {"clk": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}, "frame_len": {"direction": "output", "width": 16}, "frame_len_valid": {"direction": "output", "width": 1}, "monitor_axis_tkeep": {"direction": "input", "width": 8}, "monitor_axis_tlast": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}, "monitor_axis_tready": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}, "monitor_axis_tvalid": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}, "rst": {"direction": "input", "width": 1}}, "admission": "Match fixed-configuration cycle-exact public-port regression behavior. This is a trace oracle, not an unbounded property proof. Two additional audit input sequences are unavailable to the model.", "execution": "Native Verilator two-state simulation, unspecified initialization zero, explicit Verilog initial values retained", "editing": "Only edit the displayed original file; preserve ports, parameters, directives and license/header. Dependencies are read-only."}

64: reg [LEN_WIDTH-1:0] frame_len_next;
65: reg frame_len_valid_reg = 1'b0;
66: reg frame_len_valid_next;
67: reg frame_reg = 1'b0;
68: reg frame_next;
69: 
70: assign frame_len = frame_len_reg;
71: assign frame_len_valid = frame_len_valid_reg;
72: 
73: integer offset, i, bit_cnt;
74: 
75: always @* begin
76:     i = 0; 
77:     frame_len_next = frame_len_reg;
78:     frame_len_valid_next = 1'b0;
79:     frame_next = frame_reg;
80: 
81:     if (monitor_axis_tready && monitor_axis_tvalid) begin
82:

85:             
86:             frame_len_valid_next = 1'b1;
87:             frame_next = 1'b0;
88:         end else if (!frame_reg) begin
89:             
90:             frame_len_next = 0;
91:             frame_next = 1'b1;
92:         end
93: 
94:         
95:         if (KEEP_ENABLE) begin
96:             bit_cnt = 0;
97:             for (i = 0; i <= KEEP_WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin
98:                 if (monitor_axis_tkeep == ({KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}}) >> (KEEP_WIDTH-i)) bit_cnt = i;
99:             end
100:             frame_len_next = frame_len_next + bit_cnt;
101:         end else begin
102:             frame_len_next = frame_len_next + 1;
103:         end
104:     end
105: end
106: 
107: always @(posedge clk) begin
108:     if (rst) begin
109:         frame_len_reg <= 0;
110:         frame_len_valid_reg <= 0;
111:         frame_reg <= 1'b0;
112:     end else begin
113:         frame_len_reg <= frame_len_next;
114:         frame_len_valid_reg <= frame_len_valid_next;
115:         frame_reg <= frame_next;
116:     end
117: end
